name: deepseek-harness
description: DeepSeek Harness: Everything is a Plugin.
description_zh: DeepSeek Harness：一切皆插件。开源 agent 运行时，官方核心仓库。
description_en: DeepSeek Harness: everything is a plugin. Official open-source agent runtime.

name: colleague-skill
description: Transforming cold farewells into warm skills.
description_zh: 把冰冷的离别化为温暖的 Skill，欢迎加入数字生命 1.0。
description_en: Turn a cold farewell into a warm Skill. Welcome to Digital Life 1.0.

name: iPolloWork
description: Next-gen AI workspace with DSH subagent delegation.
description_zh: 下一代源码可得的 AI 工作台，接入 DeepSeek Harness 做子代理委派。
description_en: Next-gen source-available AI workspace that integrates DSH for subagent delegation.

name: OpenBiliClaw
description: Local-first content discovery agent and DSH plugin.
description_zh: 本地私有的跨平台内容发现 Agent，支持 B 站、小红书、抖音等，可作 DSH 插件。
description_en: Local-first cross-platform content discovery agent; also ships as a DSH plugin.

name: deeptide
description: Swift-native macOS coding agent for DeepSeek.
description_zh: 为 DeepSeek 打造的 Swift 原生 macOS 编程代理。
description_en: A Swift-native macOS coding agent, built by DeepSeek, for DeepSeek.

name: dsh-web-ui
description: DSH Web UI plugin and skin collection.
description_zh: DSH Web UI 插件与皮肤合集：任务板、Git 图、侧栏、远程移动端、宠物与皮肤中心。
description_en: Plugin and skin collection for DSH Web UI: task board, git graph, sidebar, mobile UI, pet, skins.

name: mobius
description_zh: 开源自进化 Agent OS，连接团队、智能体、设备与算力。
description_en: The first self-evolving open-source Agent OS, connecting team, agents, devices, and compute.

name: modlens
description: First vision plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description_zh: DSH 首个视觉插件：粘贴图片，得到 OCR、版面与语义的结构化证据。
description_en: First vision plugin for DSH. Paste an image, get structured OCR, layout, and semantics.

name: agent-vision-toolkit
description_zh: 为纯文本模型设计的视觉工具箱：多图理解、OCR、UI 还原与 GUI 自动化。
description_en: Vision toolkit for text-only models: multi-image Q&A, OCR, UI restore, GUI automation.

name: helloagents
description_zh: 自主高级智能伙伴：不仅分析问题，更持续工作直到实现并验证。
description_en: An autonomous senior partner that keeps working until the change is implemented and verified.

name: sandbase-harness
description_zh: 开源 CMA 兼容 agent 运行时，本地多代理、任意模型、MCP 与仪表盘。
description_en: Open-source CMA-compatible agent runtime with local multi-agent, any model, MCP, and a dashboard.

name: dsh-TUI
description: Claude Code-style fullscreen TUI for DSH.
description_zh: Claude Code 风格全屏终端插件：像素鲸鱼顶栏、思考流、Esc 回滚与 TPS 仪表。
description_en: Claude Code-style fullscreen TUI: pixel-whale header, thought stream, Esc rewind, TPS gauge.

name: awesome-dsh-plugins
description: Radar index of DSH plugin candidates.
description_zh: 雷达索引：自动扫描发现的 DSH 插件候选，合格后移入精选目录。
description_en: Radar index that auto-scans DSH plugin candidates; qualified ones move into a curated catalog.

name: DSH-better-sidebar
description_zh: 完整侧栏工作台，支持第三方注册 Tab，内置文件、终端、Git 与子代理。
description_en: A full sidebar workbench with third-party tabs, files, terminal, Git, and subagents.

name: awesome-dsh-plugin
description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件精选列表。
description_en: A curated list of plugins for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
